It just means the language being used to describe them is so broad that it loses its real-world meaning. 
When every observer is operating on their own arbitrary axis, the reasoning isn't necessarily "wrong" by its own internal rules, but it becomes functionally meaningless because it no longer anchors to a shared, objective physical reality. It just spins in place.
